To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the carbon black waste generated from gasification processes of crude oil bottom can be treated to remove heavy metals and to reduce the toxicity of the leachate.

(1) chemical treatment of the carbon black residue with HNO3 can remove the hazardous heavy metals (Ni and V) and make the carbon black residue less toxic, (2) the treated carbon black waste is a good adsorbent for dye removal, and (3) the carbon black waste is also a potential source of conductive carbon material.
the carbon black waste can be used as an absorbent material for dye removal after treatment with acid leaching, and it can be also used as a conductive material.
